---
title: "Gerry Rafferty"
subtitle: "Life, music and historical context"
---

```{python}
import duckdb
from IPython.display import display

con = duckdb.connect("../data/processed/music_life.duckdb", read_only=True)

artist = con.execute("""
SELECT name, birth_date, death_date, birth_place
FROM artists WHERE slug='gerry-rafferty'
""").df()

focus = con.execute("""
SELECT title, original_release_date, spotify_url
FROM albums
WHERE is_focus_album
ORDER BY original_release_date
""").df()

display(artist)
display(focus)
```

## Research lens

This pilot follows **Gerry Rafferty**, with **City to City** as the first focus album.

The production dashboard is intended to combine documented life events, collaborators, external credits, focus-album personnel and songs, historical chart trajectories, contemporary chart context, Spotify links, and clearly labelled sourced versus project-derived interpretation.

> Starter rows are build-test data only, not the final source-backed dataset.
